items.title: Tesla-SpaceX Talks Are Moving at “Warp Speed.” SpaceX’s IPO Lock-Up Ends Dec. 8
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSpaceX stock fell 3% Tuesday morning as reports showed three banks already negotiating a possible all-stock merger with Tesla. LumaSenti’s Larry Goldberg expected the committees to form late this year at the earliest, and he calls the pace “warp speed.
